title: Class I: Electric Rider Forklift Training
shortDescription: Designed for electric rider forklifts used in warehouses and distribution centers.
longDescription: Our Class I Forklift Training program is designed for operators of electric motor rider trucks, including counterbalanced rider trucks. Operators learn how to safely navigate busy warehouse floors, manage battery charging and maintenance protocols, execute safe load handling maneuvers, and ensure stability rules. The class includes both theoretical training and hands-on evaluations required for OSHA certification.
seoTitle: Class 1 Forklift Training: Electric Rider Trucks | BHG
metaDescription: Onsite Class 1 forklift training for electric motor rider trucks: battery charging, stability, load handling and the hands-on evaluation OSHA 1910.178 requires.

title: Class II: Narrow Aisle Forklift Training
shortDescription: Training for narrow aisle lift trucks used in tight warehouse layouts.
longDescription: Class II Forklift Training specializes in narrow aisle lift trucks, such as reach trucks and order pickers. Operating in compact storage layouts requires expert spatial awareness and specialized steering techniques. This course focuses on narrow aisle maneuvering skills, high-rack rack and pallet safety methods, stability controls, and picking processes to maximize safety and efficiency in high-density storage facilities.
seoTitle: Class 2 Forklift Training: Reach Trucks & Order Pickers | BHG
metaDescription: Class 2 narrow aisle training for reach trucks and order pickers: high-rack load handling, tight-aisle steering and the OSHA operator evaluation.

title: Class III: Electric Pallet Jack & Walkie Training
shortDescription: Certification for electric pallet jacks and walk behind lift equipment.
longDescription: Class III training covers electric pallet jacks, walk-behind lift equipment, and walkie-riders. These machines are common in grocery, retail, and manufacturing environments. Our course teaches operators walk-behind control safety, safe travel and stopping steps, load capacity tracking, and navigating tight spaces around foot traffic to ensure pedestrian and operator safety.
seoTitle: Class 3 Forklift Training: Electric Pallet Jacks | BHG
metaDescription: Class 3 training for electric pallet jacks, walkies and walkie-riders: walk-behind controls, travel and stopping, pedestrian safety and an onsite evaluation.

title: Class IV: Indoor Cushion Tire Forklift Training
shortDescription: Training for indoor engine powered forklifts with cushion tires.
longDescription: Class IV Forklift Training covers internal combustion engine trucks equipped with solid cushion tires. These forklifts are commonly powered by LP gas (propane), diesel, or gasoline, and are designed for smooth, indoor industrial floors. Operators learn fuel-powered truck operation, safe indoor refueling procedures, tire maintenance, indoor ventilation rules, and OSHA-compliant stability standards.
seoTitle: Class 4 Forklift Training: Cushion Tire IC Forklifts | BHG
metaDescription: Class 4 training for propane, gas and diesel cushion-tire forklifts on indoor floors: refueling, ventilation, stability and a hands-on operator evaluation.

title: Class V: Outdoor Pneumatic Tire Forklift Training
shortDescription: Certification for outdoor forklifts with pneumatic tires and engines.
longDescription: Class V Forklift Training is built for outdoor forklifts powered by internal combustion engines and riding on large, heavy-duty pneumatic tires. These trucks operate on rough surfaces, gravel, and outdoor terrain. This course covers outdoor terrain safety, load balance on uneven surfaces, engine diagnostics, mast operations, and specialized visibility guidelines for high-impact industrial operations.
seoTitle: Class 5 Forklift Training: Pneumatic Tire Forklifts | BHG
metaDescription: Class 5 forklift training for pneumatic-tire, engine-powered trucks used outdoors: uneven surfaces, load balance, visibility and a hands-on OSHA evaluation.

title: Class VI: Tow Tractor & Pulling System Training
shortDescription: Training for tow tractors and powered pulling equipment systems.
longDescription: Class VI training certifies operators for tow tractors, tuggers, and powered pulling equipment systems. Commonly used in airports, large manufacturing plants, and logistics yards, tow tractors haul trailers rather than lift them. This course focuses on towing limits, acceleration/stopping control, hitching safety, and trailing load dynamics to prevent jackknifing and route incidents.
seoTitle: Class 6 Tow Tractor & Tugger Training | BHG Forklift
metaDescription: Class 6 training for electric and engine-powered tow tractors and tuggers: towing limits, hitching, stopping distance and trailing loads, at your facility.

title: Class VII: Rough Terrain Forklift Training
shortDescription: Certification for rough terrain forklifts used on construction sites.
longDescription: Class VII Forklift Training is designed for rough-terrain forklifts, including telehandlers and straight-mast rough terrain trucks. Primarily used in construction, forestry, and agriculture, these heavy machines handle uneven slopes and extreme terrain. Operators learn uneven ground operation, telescopic boom extend/retract limits, stability triangle mechanics, load chart calculations, and wind/weather hazards.
seoTitle: Class 7 Forklift Training: Rough Terrain & Telehandler | BHG
metaDescription: Class 7 rough terrain forklift and telehandler training for construction and agriculture: load charts, boom limits, slopes, weather and an onsite evaluation.
